objective: Keep legacy solver intents unchanged and separately meter learning purposes with durable recovery and completed parent-response audit.

implementation.ownership: Independent task/run plus frozen owner/source hashes; hashes do not admit source permission. Same owner cannot mix generations or sources.
implementation.recovery: Reservation consumes shared call count. Preflight failure stays reserved and undispatched; dispatched/unknown never auto-resend; completed full responses replay without a provider call.
implementation.format_repair: Completed same-owner/source/provider/model parent required; complete response and observations recursively recomputed, with at most 128 calls including current.
implementation.usage: Learning normalized and raw usage require exact nonnegative integers and consistent sums. Missing or invalid usage is retained, not estimated.
implementation.limits: All learning subpurposes share owner call count and known-token threshold. This is not a hard total-token or cross-operation budget; actual fees remain unknown.
implementation.full_source_workflow: Separate next package; bottom-level hashes do not prove actual request or learning permission.

initial_ruff_failure.reason: Three new workflow import blocks and serialized-invalid-evidence exception category; imports corrected, intentional ValueError documented. No core runtime changes after the ledger tests.

remaining: Approved model-derived versions and Agent startup bridge
